stem: An independently classified sample contains 200 people with disease and 800 without disease. A test is positive in 160 people with disease and 80 without disease. An analyst reports 160/240 as specificity. Which of the following calculations should replace that value?

options.label: A
options.explanation: This ratio measures sensitivity: detected cases divided by all people with disease. Specificity instead concerns correctly negative results among the independently identified group without disease.
options.misconception: Uses detection among diseased people to estimate specificity.

options.label: B
options.explanation: This is positive predictive value, because it divides true positives by all positive results. Specificity requires the disease-free group as the denominator and true negatives as the numerator.
options.misconception: Substitutes the positive-test denominator for the disease-free denominator.

options.label: C
options.explanation: This ratio asks what fraction of negative results come from people without disease. Specificity instead divides true negatives by all people without disease, including those who tested positive.
options.misconception: Confuses negative predictive value with specificity.

options.label: D
options.explanation: Among the 800 people without disease, 80 test positive and 720 test negative. Specificity is therefore 720/800, or 90%, using the disease-free group as its denominator.
options.misconception: No misconception: specificity counts true negatives among all noncases.

options.label: E
options.explanation: This ratio describes the fraction of the sample without disease. It does not assess whether the test correctly classified those people and therefore is not a measure of specificity.
options.misconception: Treats the proportion without disease as test classification accuracy.

context:
Learning objective: Calculate specificity from true negatives divided by all people without disease.

Among the 800 people without disease, 80 test positive and 720 test negative. Specificity is therefore 720/800, or 90%, using the disease-free group as its denominator.
